newsitem.title: INDIA: India Sundram down 5.6 pct after results.
newsitem.headline: India Sundram down 5.6 pct after results.

text.p: Shares of Indian auto-component maker, Sundram Fasteners fell 5.6 percent to 580.0 rupees at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Friday, after the firm posted a small rise in 1996/97 (April-March) net profit, dealers said.
Sundram Fasteners was traded 34.75 rupees lower at the BSE, with 310 shares changing hands by noon.
The company on Thursday announced a 5.5 percent rise in net profit to 320.5 million rupees against 303.7 million rupees in the previous year.
Interest charges rose 48 percent due to higher borrowing costs and modernisation and expansion schemes, the firm said. It added fixed assets worth 420 million rupees in 1996/97.
At the National Stock Exchange, Sundram shares fell 23.0 rupees, or 3.7 percent, to 590, with 1,350 shares traded.
